subject: Important Update Regarding Your Flight Reservation
body: Dear valued customer, We would like to inform you that there has been a schedule change for your upcoming flight reservation. The departure time has been shifted by 2 hours due to unforeseen circumstances. Please review the updated itinerary attached to this email and contact us if you have any concerns or need assistance. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding. Thank you for choosing our airline for your travel needs.
